module_concept_edges.description: The Module x Concept crossing. One row per (module, concept) pair for which at least one EXPLICIT authored tag exists - a stage's `concepts` tag or a knowledge-map node's reviewed `concept_ids`. Never inferred from titles, prose, notes, sources, or similarity; absence means not mapped, never that no relationship exists. Ordered by (module_id, concept_id).

evidence.description: Why this cell is filled. At least one item: an edge with no evidence is an inferred edge, and this projection does not publish those.

stageConceptEvidence.description: A stage's explicit `concepts` tag. Retains unit, study-map and stage identity, so a filled cell drills into the exact stage.

knowledgeNodeEvidence.description: A knowledge-map node's reviewed `concept_ids`. Retains unit and node identity.
